query: SELECT violator_id, COUNT(*) as violation_count FROM estishraf_llm_traffic_violation WHERE violation_type_latin_description IN ('NOT WEARING A SEATBELT', 'Not Wearing a Seatbelt - Auto Detection') AND status_description IN ('Issued to violator and paid', 'Issued to violator but un-paid') GROUP BY violator_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY violation_count DESC LIMIT 1000
